name: co-corporate-income-tax
description: Colombian corporate income tax (impuesto sobre la renta de personas jurídicas) for año gravable 2026, filed in May 2027 (April for grandes contribuyentes). Covers who is a national company (ET art. 12-1), the 35% general rate (art. 240), the 5 extra points for financial entities, the extractive and hydro surcharges, the 15% and 9% special rates, free-zone users (art. 240-1), the minimum tax (tasa de tributación depurada, TTD, art. 240 par. 6) with its top-up, deductions, thin capitalisation (art. 118-1), 12-year loss carry-forward (art. 147), tax discounts and their 25% cap, dividends between companies (art. 242-1) and to non-residents (art. 245), withholding on payments abroad (art. 408), Form 110, anticipo, deadlines by NIT and penalties, plus the choice between the ordinary regime and the Régimen Simple (arts. 905, 908) with the 2026 UVT of COP 52,374. Trigger on: impuesto de renta sociedades 2026, tarifa 35%, tasa mínima de tributación, TTD, impuesto a adicionar, Formulario 110, SA
